cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, random
rng = random.Random(11)
def build(name, U, borders, epoch, cap, lanes_per_step, serve_all, rank_pool):
    Q, L = 16, 8
    steps = []; t = 0
    for k in range(40000):
        t += 1
        lanes = rng.sample(range(L), lanes_per_step)
        arrs = []
        for j, ln in enumerate(lanes):
            rk = rng.randrange(U) if rank_pool is None else rng.choice(rank_pool)
            arrs.append({'id': 'p-%d-%d' % (k, j), 'lane': ln, 'rank': rk})
        steps.append({'t': t, 'serve': serve_all, 'arrivals': arrs})
    req = {'mode': 'stream', 'banks': Q, 'lanes': L, 'limit': U,
           'borders': borders, 'capacity': cap, 'epoch': epoch, 'steps': steps}
    data = json.dumps(req).encode()
    open('/workspace/tmp/big_%s.json' % name, 'wb').write(data)
    print(name, len(data), 'bytes')
build('stream4', 40, [0,1,2,3,5,8,13,21,34,40], 1, 20000, 3, True, [0,1,2,3,5,8,13,21,34,39])
build('stream5', 2147483648, [0,1,2,3,5,8,13,21,34,40,100,1000,10000,100000,1000000,10000000,100000000,1000000000,2147483648], 0, 20000, 3, True, [0,5,2147483647])
EOF
